segments.normalizedSource: The following code reverses the channel ordering of a pixel buffer:
segments.contextAfter:
```swift
let pixelBuffer = vImage.PixelBuffer<vImage.InterleavedFx4>(
    pixelValues: [10, 20, 30, 40],
    size: .init(width: 1, height: 1))

pixelBuffer.withUnsafePointerToVImageBuffer { buf in
    _ = vImagePermuteChannels_ARGBFFFF(buf,
                                      buf,
                                      [3, 2, 1, 0],
                                      vImage_Flags(kvImageNoFlags))
}

// Prints "[40, 30, 20, 10]".
print(pixelBuffer.array)
```
